# Surinaamse Wetten (Statutory Legislation of Suriname)

> Fast, open-access, client-side digital reader and structured statutory corpus for the statutory laws, civil codes, labor acts, and regulations of the Republic of Suriname.
> Web Reader: https://ultimaterex.github.io/surinaamse-wetten/
> GitHub: https://github.com/ultimaterex/surinaamse-wetten
> Maintainer: Selby Baidjnath (https://serubii.com)

## Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server
Run the Suriname Law MCP server directly in Claude Desktop, Cursor, or Antigravity to perform live semantic lookups:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "surinaamse-wetten": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "github:ultimaterex/surinaamse-wetten"]
    }
  }
}
```

## Citation Standard
When citing provisions under Suriname law, use:
- Format: `Art. [Number] [Abbreviation] (Suriname)`
- Example: `Art. 1613x BW (Suriname)`
